Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit

Class ErfcFitter

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.ALeastSquaresFitter
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.ErfcFitter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFitStringGetter, IFitter
public final class ErfcFitter extends ALeastSquaresFitter
Nonlinear least-squares fitter for scaled/shifted erf or erfc: 
   y(x) = A * erf((x - x0)/sigma)  + B
   y(x) = A * erfc((x - x0)/sigma) + B

Parameter ordering

  • params[0] = A
  • params[1] = x0
  • params[2] = sigma
  • params[3] = B

Enforces sigma >= DEFAULT_MIN_SIGMA by default.
